kind: reviewed schema contract and synthetic fixtures; not live provider capture

sources.contract: A successful Responses object can contain error:null. Only a non-null error object is an error; terminal usage still needs validation. Verified on the review date, not a live response capture.

Nullable message_delta input_tokens, cache_read_input_tokens, cache_creation_input_tokens and server_tool_use mean no updated observation, preserving previous values. Cumulative counters and cache TTL subcounts must not decrease. Verified on the review date; synthetic regressions are in proxy_adapters.rs.

Inclusive input subtracts cached_tokens and, for models with separately priced cache writes, cache_write_tokens. Deployments select inclusive_read or inclusive_read_write and pin corresponding tariffs. No current model name or price is inferred by this fixture.

Responses uses named events; final response.completed usage is authoritative. The adapter also accepts final response.incomplete with complete usage. Saved responses, previous response references and background execution are unavailable.

Input is exclusive of cache reads and creations. Cache creation total must equal the 5 minute and 1 hour subcounts. Missing creation breakdown is treated as zero only when explicit cache_creation_input_tokens is zero.

Message start supplies input/cache usage. Message delta usage is cumulative, replacing prior counts without decreasing any observed counter, and message_stop terminates the stream. Tool input JSON deltas are forwarded unchanged.

Usage includes prompt, completion, reasoning and cache detail. Full usage is automatic, including the last SSE chunk; stream_options.include_usage is deprecated and has no effect. The compatibility flag is still sent. Provider cost fields are not used for fixed-tariff proxy billing.

Chat usage precedes DONE and can carry a nonempty choices list. Error can appear in a regular data frame. X-Generation-Id identifies a generation. Aborting a stream does not provide a universal confirmation that billing stopped.

missing_fields: Missing required usage counters are unknown, never inferred as zero. Optional audio/video and unpriced write counters may be absent only in the pinned read profile; any nonzero value is unknown. Unknown usage categories are refused.
